rules_text: Gain 2 Time.
fr_rules_text: Gagnez 2 Temps.
en_rules_text: Gain 2 Time.

Name: Prep
rules_text: Gain 1 Time.
fr_rules_text: Gagnez 1 Temps.
en_rules_text: Gain 1 Time.

Name: Purify
rules_text: Peel up to 2 cards. If you Peel one or more Statuses this way, draw 1.
fr_rules_text: Epluchez jusqu'a 2 cartes. Si vous Epluchez au moins un Statut ainsi, piochez 1.
en_rules_text: Peel up to 2 cards. If you Peel one or more Statuses this way, draw 1.

Name: Raclette
rules_text: Other Cheese dishes you present get +1 Taste.
fr_rules_text: Vos autres plats Fromage presentes gagnent +1 Gout.
en_rules_text: Other Cheese dishes you present get +1 Taste.

Name: Red Sauce Empire
rules_text: Your Tomato dishes get +1 Taste and cost 1 less to learn.
fr_rules_text: Vos plats Tomate gagnent +1 Gout et coutent 1 de moins a apprendre.
en_rules_text: Your Tomato dishes get +1 Taste and cost 1 less to learn.

Name: Review Bomb Campaign
rules_text: Whenever you add a Status to an opponent's deck, put 1 counter here. If there are 7 or more counters here at judging, you win the game.
fr_rules_text: Chaque fois que vous ajoutez un Statut au deck d'un adversaire, mettez 1 compteur ici. S'il y a au moins 7 compteurs ici au jugement, vous gagnez la partie.
en_rules_text: Whenever you add a Status to an opponent's deck, put 1 counter here. If there are 7 or more counters here at judging, you win the game.

Name: Rice Cooker
rules_text:
Rice dishes cost 1 less to learn.
The first Rice dish you learn each turn goes on top of your deck.
fr_rules_text: Les plats Riz coutent 1 de moins a apprendre. Le premier plat Riz que vous apprenez chaque tour va au-dessus de votre deck.
en_rules_text:
Rice dishes cost 1 less to learn.
The first Rice dish you learn each turn goes on top of your deck.

Name: Risotto
rules_text: During judging if you present another Rice or Cheese dish gain +1 Favor.
fr_rules_text: Au jugement si vous presentez un autre plat Riz ou Fromage gagnez +1 Faveur.
en_rules_text: During judging if you present another Rice or Cheese dish gain +1 Favor.

Name: Sashimi
rules_text: Draw 1 then discard 1.
fr_rules_text: Piochez 1 puis defaussez 1.
en_rules_text: Draw 1 then discard 1.

Name: Saucisson
rules_text: You may attach this to another Dish. If you do, gain 1 Time.
fr_rules_text: Vous pouvez attacher ce plat a un autre plat. Si vous le faites, gagnez 1 Temps.
en_rules_text: You may attach this to another Dish. If you do, gain 1 Time.

Name: Seafood Counter
rules_text: During judging if you present a Seafood dish gain +1 Favor and you may Peel 1.
fr_rules_text: Au jugement si vous presentez un plat Fruits de mer gagnez +1 Faveur et vous pouvez Eplucher 1.
en_rules_text: During judging if you present a Seafood dish gain +1 Favor and you may Peel 1.

Name: Secondo
rules_text: During judging score one Main a second time.
fr_rules_text: Au jugement scorez une deuxieme fois un Plat principal.
en_rules_text: During judging score one Main a second time.

Name: Secret Family Recipe
rules_text: Put a Dish from your discard pile into your hand. Draw 1. If it is Tomato or Cheese, gain 1 Time.
fr_rules_text: Mettez un Plat de votre defausse dans votre main. Piochez 1. S'il est Tomate ou Fromage, gagnez 1 Temps.
en_rules_text: Put a Dish from your discard pile into your hand. Draw 1. If it is Tomato or Cheese, gain 1 Time.

Name: Shame
rules_text: During judging if you present dishes from 2 or more factions, lose 1 Favor. Then Peel Shame.
fr_rules_text: Au jugement si vous presentez des plats de 2 factions ou plus, perdez 1 Faveur. Puis Epluchez Honte.
en_rules_text: During judging if you present dishes from 2 or more factions, lose 1 Favor. Then Peel Shame.

Name: Side Salad
rules_text: When you present this, choose which course it counts as.
fr_rules_text: Quand vous presentez ce plat, choisissez pour quel service il compte.
en_rules_text: When you present this, choose which course it counts as.

Name: Sloppy Joe
rules_text: During judging if you present another Tomato dish gain +1 Favor.
fr_rules_text: Au jugement si vous presentez un autre plat Tomate gagnez +1 Faveur.
en_rules_text: During judging if you present another Tomato dish gain +1 Favor.

Name: Spaghetti Bolognese
rules_text: If the Judge does not favor you this gets +2 Taste.
fr_rules_text: Si le Juge ne vous favorise pas ce plat gagne +2 Gout.
en_rules_text: If the Judge does not favor you this gets +2 Taste.

Name: Steakhouse
rules_text: Your Meat dishes get +2 Taste.
fr_rules_text: Vos plats Viande gagnent +2 Gout.
en_rules_text: Your Meat dishes get +2 Taste.

Name: Strike
rules_text: The first Technique you play each turn costs 1 more Time. Then Peel Strike.
fr_rules_text: La premiere Technique que vous jouez chaque tour coute 1 Temps de plus. Puis Epluchez Greve.
en_rules_text: The first Technique you play each turn costs 1 more Time. Then Peel Strike.

Name: Super Bowl Commercial Break
rules_text:
Draw 2.
Starting with you, each player may draw 1; each who does gains Food Coma.
fr_rules_text: Piochez 2. En commencant par vous, chaque joueur peut piocher 1; chacun qui le fait gagne Coma alimentaire.
en_rules_text:
Draw 2.
Starting with you, each player may draw 1; each who does gains Food Coma.

Name: Supersize Me!
rules_text: During judging copy one of your dishes as an additional presented dish.
fr_rules_text: Au jugement copiez l'un de vos plats comme plat presente supplementaire.
en_rules_text: During judging copy one of your dishes as an additional presented dish.

Name: Sushi Set
rules_text: During judging if you present Appetizer Main and Dessert gain +3 Favor.
fr_rules_text: Au jugement, si vous presentez Entree Plat principal et Dessert, gagnez +3 Faveur.
en_rules_text: During judging if you present Appetizer Main and Dessert gain +3 Favor.

Name: Takoyaki
rules_text: If this is your only Extra, you may Peel 1. Then look at the top 2 cards of your deck. You may put 1 on the bottom of your deck.
fr_rules_text: Si c'est votre seul Extra, vous pouvez Eplucher 1. Puis regardez les 2 premieres cartes de votre deck. Vous pouvez en mettre 1 sous votre deck.
en_rules_text: If this is your only Extra, you may Peel 1. Then look at the top 2 cards of your deck. You may put 1 on the bottom of your deck.

Name: Taste Test
rules_text: Draw 2 then discard 1. If the discarded card is a starter card or Status, you may Peel it.
fr_rules_text: Piochez 2 puis defaussez 1. Si la carte defaussee est une carte de depart ou un Statut, vous pouvez l'Eplucher.
en_rules_text: Draw 2 then discard 1. If the discarded card is a starter card or Status, you may Peel it.

Name: Tasting Menu
rules_text: When you present this, choose which course it counts as. If it completes all 3 core courses, gain 1 Time.
fr_rules_text: Quand vous presentez ce plat, choisissez pour quel service il compte. S'il complete les 3 services de base, gagnez 1 Temps.
en_rules_text: When you present this, choose which course it counts as. If it completes all 3 core courses, gain 1 Time.

Name: Tempura
rules_text: During judging if you present no duplicate core course this gets +1 Taste.
fr_rules_text: Au jugement si vous ne presentez aucun doublon de plat de base ce plat gagne +1 Gout.
en_rules_text: During judging if you present no duplicate core course this gets +1 Taste.

Name: Tiramisu
rules_text: If the Judge does not favor you gain +2 Favor.
fr_rules_text: Si le Juge ne vous favorise pas gagnez +2 Faveur.
en_rules_text: If the Judge does not favor you gain +2 Favor.

Name: Wage Inequalities
rules_text: Whenever you present one or more dishes with 5 or more Taste, each opponent gains On Strike.
fr_rules_text: Chaque fois que vous presentez au moins un plat avec au moins 5 Gout, chaque adversaire gagne En greve.
en_rules_text: Whenever you present one or more dishes with 5 or more Taste, each opponent gains On Strike.

Name: Wasabi Attack
rules_text:
Target non-seafood dish gets -2 Taste this turn.
Each player scorches 1.
Then, if your entire deck is 7 or fewer cards, gain 3 Favor.
fr_rules_text: Le plat non-Fruits de mer cible gagne -2 Gout ce tour-ci. Chaque joueur Carbonise 1. Puis, si votre deck entier contient 7 cartes ou moins, gagnez 3 Faveur.
en_rules_text:
Target non-seafood dish gets -2 Taste this turn.
Each player scorches 1.
Then, if your entire deck is 7 or fewer cards, gain 3 Favor.

Name: Wasabi Challenge
rules_text:
When you present this, Scorch 2.
Then, If your entire deck is 7 or fewer cards, gain 1 Favor.
fr_rules_text: Quand vous presentez ce plat, Carbonisez 2. Puis, si votre deck entier contient 7 cartes ou moins, gagnez 1 Faveur.
en_rules_text:
When you present this, Scorch 2.
Then, If your entire deck is 7 or fewer cards, gain 1 Favor.

Name: We Heard You Have Oil
rules_text: When drawn, discard the highest-cost card from your hand. Then Peel We Heard You Have Oil.
fr_nom: On a entendu que vous aviez du petrole
fr_Name: On a entendu que vous aviez du petrole
fr_rules_text: Quand vous piochez cette carte, defaussez la carte avec le cout le plus eleve de votre main. Puis Epluchez On a entendu que vous aviez du petrole.
en_rules_text: When drawn, discard the highest-cost card from your hand. Then Peel We Heard You Have Oil.

Name: We're Gonna Build A Wall
rules_text:
Each opponent gains a Food Coma.
Until your next turn, opponents cannot target your dishes.
fr_rules_text: Chaque adversaire gagne Coma alimentaire. Jusqu'a votre prochain tour, les adversaires ne peuvent pas cibler vos plats.
en_rules_text:
Each opponent gains a Food Coma.
Until your next turn, opponents cannot target your dishes.

Name: Without Cream!
rules_text: At the judging step of each opponent, if that opponent has more favor than you, you gain 2 Favor and that opponent loses 2 Favor.
fr_rules_text: Pendant l'etape de jugement de chaque adversaire, si cet adversaire a plus de Faveur que vous, gagnez 2 Faveur et cet adversaire perd 2 Faveur.
en_rules_text: At the judging step of each opponent, if that opponent has more favor than you, you gain 2 Favor and that opponent loses 2 Favor.

Name: Yelp Bomb
rules_text: Choose an opponent. They gain a Yelp Review. Draw 1.
fr_rules_text: Choisissez un adversaire. Il gagne Avis Yelp. Piochez 1.
en_rules_text: Choose an opponent. They gain a Yelp Review. Draw 1.

Name: Yelp Review
rules_text: During judging your highest-Taste dish gets -1 Taste. Then Peel Yelp Review.
fr_rules_text: Au jugement votre plat avec le plus de Gout gagne -1 Gout. Puis Epluchez Avis Yelp.
en_rules_text: During judging your highest-Taste dish gets -1 Taste. Then Peel Yelp Review.

Name: You Call That Sushi?
rules_text: Each opponent Scorches 1. For each Status Scorched this way, draw 1.
fr_rules_text: Chaque adversaire Carbonise 1. Pour chaque Statut Carbonise ainsi, piochez 1.
en_rules_text: Each opponent Scorches 1. For each Status Scorched this way, draw 1.
